integrity: The algebraic reduction is analytic and is replayed within the package by a finite numerical checker; numerical checks are corroborative rather than proofs of the asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specialized to \(\gamma=0\) and \(\ell_1=\ell_2=\ell_3=\pi\); it treats the nonnegative momentum spectrum and does not classify unequal lengths, \(\gamma\ne0\), or negative bands.
title: Exact equilateral crossover from positive band density to logarithmic momentum measure
